name: Haier Home Appliances
legalEntityNote: Haier is a consumer appliance brand operated within Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., the listed home-appliance platform controlled within the wider Haier Group. GE Appliances, Fisher & Paykel, Candy and other portfolio businesses retain separate brand and operating identities; regional Haier entities can hold local sales, manufacturing, import or service roles.

description: A source-backed profile separating the Haier consumer brand, Haier Smart Home and Haier Group, with products, global operations, regional entities and buyer checks.

Haier Group, Haier Smart Home, the Haier consumer brand, acquired portfolio companies, regional entities and physical factories are distinct layers and should not be generalized to every appliance or SKU.

ownership.summary: Haier Home Appliances is a consumer brand within Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., the listed home-appliance platform controlled within the wider Haier Group. Haier Smart Home also reports a multi-brand portfolio that includes GE Appliances and Fisher & Paykel, but those companies are not interchangeable with the Haier brand or with one another. Regional legal entities, manufacturers, importers and service providers must be verified independently.
ownership.parentCompany: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., within Haier Group

productPortfolio.name: Refrigeration and kitchen appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Haier-branded refrigerators, freezers, cooking appliances and dishwashers serve broad household segments across regional assortments.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Buyers should compare dimensions, climate class, voltage, installation, energy labels and service coverage by market and model.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Washers, dryers and combined laundry formats are central to Haier's global smart-home portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify manufacturer, factory, capacity claims, local certification, spare parts and warranty for the exact regional SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Air, water and home-comfort products
productPortfolio.positioning: Regional Haier ranges can include air conditioning, water heating and other connected home systems.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Category scope and installation obligations vary sharply by country, so local contracting and compliance evidence is essential.

productPortfolio.name: Cleaning appliances in selected markets
productPortfolio.positioning: Haier markets products such as robot and handheld vacuums in selected countries, including an officially documented India range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not infer a global cleaning assortment from one market; check app region, accessories, batteries, filters and service availability.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Haier Smart Home describes a local-for-local global system spanning research, manufacturing, marketing and service.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Haier Smart Home global operating model
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require exact-SKU factory, origin, exporter and compliance evidence rather than assigning a global platform site to the product.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Haier Smart Home reports multiple portfolio businesses and regional operating networks under the listed company.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Keep Haier, GE Appliances, Fisher & Paykel and other brand-company records separate in supplier qualification.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Haier India's official launch documents named robot-vacuum products for that market.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the regional model number, legal manufacturer, origin, radio approval, app and warranty before cross-border sourcing.

marketsChannels.evidence: Haier Smart Home reports a global network designed around localized brands, products, channels and service.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the local contracting company, authorized distributor, importer and after-sales provider for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Haier appliances are sold through country sites, retailers, ecommerce channels, distributors and project channels, with assortments varying by region.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm channel authorization, territory, installation duties, spare-parts support and marketplace restrictions.

marketsChannels.evidence: The Haier Smart Home portfolio uses multiple independent consumer brands rather than a single universal channel identity.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not treat a Haier authorization as rights to GE Appliances, Fisher & Paykel or another portfolio brand.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Haier's strength is a large localized appliance platform with broad categories and a portfolio of independently operated global brands. That same breadth makes identity control essential: Haier Group, Haier Smart Home, the Haier consumer brand, acquired companies and local entities have related but different roles.
